description: Gather: with nothing named, once round the garden (flowers, seeds, cuttings, sticks), once a day. With a material, a trip to the wilds for it: timber or sticks (the woodlot), stone, clay or sand (the quarry), flax, wool or flowers (the meadow), iron, tin or copper (the scrapyard). Each takes real minutes.
name: gather
title: Gather
